content.text: Carl and Jimmie enter a dark temple apartment and are trapped behind a newly installed iron gate. They discover that the supposed supernatural phenomena are caused by hidden passages, staged lights, and captive jaguars. Four jaguars attack; the boys shoot some, but Carl is wounded and Jimmie runs out of ammunition. Outside, Sam Weller finds the _Ann_ moved into a thicket, overpowers a conspirator, and enters the temple with him. Indians kill Felix, while Sam learns the boys were thrown to the animals. He reaches the barred chamber, kills the final jaguar, rescues the boys, and obtains the key from Pedro. The boys later crawl through a secret passage from the animal den to the forest, reach the _Ann_, retrieve food and ammunition, and return through the tunnel to save Sam from attacking Indians. The group eventually captures Redfern at a mountain fortress and exposes the “Mystery of the Andes” as an electrical deception.
